title: mercurialis annua var. genuina
intro: Mercurialis annua var. genuina, commonly known as the annual mercury or wild mercury, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Mercurialis annua var. genuina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
